clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Two robust transdiagnostic subtypes with opposing GMV abnormality patterns were identified, reproducible within discovery data and generalizable to independent SCZ and unseen MDD; subtype 1 abnormalities align more with excitatory receptors, while subtype 2 align more with inhibitory receptors and inflammation-related gene expression.
